decode_parity.scope: one appended token; full causal forward compared with KV-cache decode

decode_profile.cold_scope: first token after fresh prefill; warmed model, not cold allocator or device
decode_profile.timing_instrumentation: FLOP/trace hooks disabled during timed decode
decode_profile.cuda_event_scope: device elapsed includes launch gaps; not summed kernel time

prefill_observed_gemm.scope: Linear matmuls plus explicit SDPA QK^T/AV; excludes non-matmul operations

prefill_active_weight_proxy.interpretation: touched-weight working-set proxy; not RAM residency or DRAM bytes

prefill_execution.cell_execution_scope: forward Cell module calls; repeated Cell visits are counted repeatedly

decode_profile.profiler_scope: profiler event/memory proxy; not physical DRAM traffic
decode_profile.memory_traffic_note: not inferred from touched weights or allocator counters
decode_profile.timing_scope: host elapsed includes route/indexing/kernel launch/synchronization; CUDA event is device elapsed

measurement_isolation: single worker; caller must stop all other GPU training first
